title: GODMAN-LAUNCH — scripts/godman-version-bump.sh to bump all 8 packages to same version
description: Create scripts/godman-version-bump.sh that bumps all 8 godman package.json version fields (pact, lax, score, signal, soul, amf, drs, sdk) to a specified version string. Supports --dry-run. Uses node for JSON editing to preserve formatting.
